subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should this issue remain the canonical request for separated/merged channel timelines, be closed as satisfied by current Group by channel behavior, or be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901?
rationale: Current main has partial channel grouping, but a merged all-channel timeline changes UX, privacy, routing, and Gateway/session semantics that automation should not choose.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Scope Timeline
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-defined separated/merged channel timeline contract before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Sessions page Group by channel plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining merged-timeline and tabbed-view semantics under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if one broader sessions workspace should own the design.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Scope Timeline
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-defined separated/merged channel timeline contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the closest merged Control UI session grouping work and is the best current routing candidate for the product boundary decision.
